name: Feels Like
description: Heat index and wind chill from temperature, humidity and wind, offline, with a coloured thermometer, the health risk and advice.
prompt: A feels like temperature calculator that works offline. Enter the air temperature, humidity and wind speed with big sliders, in Celsius or Fahrenheit and km/h or mph, and calculate the heat index when it is hot and the wind chill when it is cold. Show the result big on a coloured thermometer with a word from freezing to dangerous heat, the risk for frostbite or heat stroke, and practical advice. Add a button to fill the values from the current weather with the free Open-Meteo API and my location
author: gonzaroman
